items.title: Microsoft Disrupted Vanilla Tempest Attack by Revoking Certificates Used to Sign Fake Teams File
items.description: Microsoft announced that it had revoked more than 200 digital certificates exploited by the notorious Vanilla Tempest hacking group. This action effectively disrupted an ongoing campaign where attackers impersonated Microsoft Teams installations to infiltrate corporate networks and deploy ransomware. The operation, uncovered in late September, highlights the evolving tactics of ransomware…

items.title: LevelBlue Announces Plans to Acquire XDR Provider Cybereason
items.description: The deal, which builds on LevelBlue’s recent acquisition of Trustwave and Aon, aims to provide customers with a broad portfolio of extended detection and response (XDR), managed detection and response (MDR), and forensic services.

items.title: Microsoft Security Update Causes Active Directory Sync Issues on Windows Server 2025
